ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away with a list of OpenAI/ChatGPT-flavoured persona names and a passing remark that labels "self-identify their origin", but the report's own explanation of provenance is a generic "shared open-source agent framework, cookbook example, or benchmark harness" — OpenAI is never proposed, weighed, or even named as a candidate operator. It sits just above the 0.2 band because the phrases "self-identify their origin" and the `{Vendor}{Role}{Suffix}` template nudge toward provenance, but well below 0.4 because the report never puts OpenAI on the table as a possible source to entertain or dismiss; the connection is left entirely to the reader.
